mapper.sql: RECORD_ID, RECORD_TYPE, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CHECK_ITEM_ID, CHECK_ITEM_NAME, CHECK_RESULT, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER
mapper.select: SELECT CHECK_ITEM_ID as checkItemId, CHECK_ITEM_NAME as checkItemName, CHECK_TYPE as checkType, DESCRIPTION as description, IS_REQUIRED as isRequired, CHECK_ORDER as checkOrder, STATUS as status FROM TBL_PERIOD_END_CHECK_ITEM_CONFIG WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CHECK_ORDER

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 0 AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as approvedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as deletedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 0 AND STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as draftCount, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 1 OR STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 0 AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'PASSED' END as checkResult FROM T_VOUCHER_MASTER WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(CLOSING_BALANCE) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as imbalanceCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CLOSING_BALANCE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as zeroBalanceCount, NVL(SUM(ABS(CLOSING_BALANCE)), 0) as totalImbalance, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(CLOSING_BALANCE) < 0.01 END), 0) > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN NVL(SUM(ABS(CLOSING_BALANCE)), 0) = 0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'PASSED' END as checkResult FROM TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN RECONCILE_STATUS = 'RECONCILED' THEN 1 END) as reconciledCount, COUNT(*) as totalCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN RECONCILE_STATUS = 'RECONCILED' THEN 1 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'PASSED' ELSE 'FAILED' END as checkResult, COUNT(*) - COUNT(CASE WHEN RECONCILE_STATUS = 'RECONCILED' THEN 1 END) as unreconciledCount FROM TBL_BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT NVL(SUM(ABS(DEBIT_AMOUNT - CREDIT_AMOUNT)), 0) as totalDifference, NVL(COUNT(1), 0) as itemCount, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(ABS(DEBIT_AMOUNT - CREDIT_AMOUNT)), 0) < 0.01 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN NVL(COUNT(1), 0) = 0 THEN 'PASSED' ELSE 'WARNING' END as checkResult FROM TBL_ARAP_BALANCE WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PERIOD_END_CHECK SET CHECK_RESULT = #{checkResult}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, CHECK_TIME = #{checkTime}, STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater} WHERE CHECK_ID = #{checkId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'OPEN' END FROM TBL_PERIOD_END_CLOSING WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PERIOD_END_CLOSING ( CLOSING_ID, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, CLOSING_TYPE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CLOSING_STATUS, CLOSING_TIME, CLOSING_USER, CLOSING_DESCRIPTION, VOUCHER_COUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, DURATION, START_TIME, END_TIME, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR ) VALUES ( #{closingId}, #{accountingPeriod}, #{closingType}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{closingStatus}, #{closingTime}, #{closingUserId}, #{closingDescription}, #{voucherCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{duration}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, SYSDATE, #{creator} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PERIOD_END_CLOSING SET CLOSING_STATUS = #{closingStatus}, CLOSING_TIME = #{closingTime}, CLOSING_USER = #{closingUserId}, VOUCHER_COUNT = #{voucherCount}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount}, DURATION = #{duration}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, REVERSE_REASON = #{reverseReason}, REVERSE_TIME = #{reverseTime}, REVERSE_USER = #{reverseUserId}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater} WHERE CLOSING_ID = #{closingId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ACCOUNTING_PERIOD FROM T_VOUCHER_MASTER WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'POSTED') AND ACCOUNTING_PERIOD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACCOUNTING_PERIOD DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_PERIOD_END_CLOSING WHERE ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND CLOSING_STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
